question: Where can a consumer file a complaint for a defective refrigerator worth Rs 35,000?
ground_truth: District Consumer Commission under Section 34 & 35 of Consumer Protection Act 2019 (Pecuniary limit up to 50 Lakhs).

question: What is the time limit for a CPIO to provide information requested under the RTI Act?
ground_truth: Within 30 days under Section 7(1), or within 48 hours if it concerns the life or liberty of a person.

question: What are the eligibility requirements for the PM-KISAN annual 6000 rupees benefit?
ground_truth: Small and marginal farmer families owning cultivable land with Aadhaar eKYC completed; tax payers excluded.

question: What is the pecuniary jurisdiction of the State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission?
ground_truth: Value of goods or services exceeding 50 Lakh rupees up to 2 Crore rupees under Section 47.

question: Under what section can an aggrieved citizen file a First Appeal under RTI?
ground_truth: Section 19(1) of the RTI Act within 30 days to the First Appellate Authority.

question: दुकानदाराने वॉशिंग मशीन नादुरुस्त दिल्यास कोणत्या कायद्यानुसार तक्रार करता येते?
ground_truth: ग्राहक संरक्षण कायदा २०१९ च्या कलम ३४ व ३५ अंतर्गत जिल्हा ग्राहक आयोगाकडे तक्रार करता येते.

question: What health coverage amount is provided under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
ground_truth: Rs 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empanelled hospitals.

question: What penalty can be imposed on a CPIO for refusing an RTI application without reasonable cause?
ground_truth: Rs 250 each day up to a maximum limit of Rs 25,000 under Section 20.

question: What is the pecuniary limit of the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC)?
ground_truth: Complaints where consideration exceeds two crore rupees under Section 58 of Consumer Protection Act 2019.

question: What is the statutory limitation period for filing a consumer complaint?
ground_truth: Within 2 years from the date on which the cause of action arose under Section 69 of CPA 2019.

question: What is the application fee for filing an RTI request to a central public authority?
ground_truth: Rupees 10 under Section 6 of the RTI Act 2005.

question: How long does a public authority have to transfer an RTI application to another authority?
ground_truth: Within five days from the date of receipt under Section 6(3) of the RTI Act.

question: Are senior citizens aged 70 and above eligible for Ayushman Bharat regardless of income?
ground_truth: Yes, under Ayushman Vay Vandana Card, all senior citizens aged 70+ receive universal Rs 5 Lakh coverage.

question: Who is disqualified from receiving the PM-KISAN cash benefit?
ground_truth: Income tax payers, institutional landholders, and serving/retired government officers.

question: What liability does a product manufacturer face for a manufacturing defect causing harm?
ground_truth: Product liability action under Section 84 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019.

question: How many days does an opposite party get to respond after receiving a consumer complaint?
ground_truth: Within 30 days, extendable by up to 15 days under Section 38 of CPA 2019.

question: Within how many days must a Second Appeal under RTI be filed before the Information Commission?
ground_truth: Within ninety days from the date on which the decision was received under Section 19(3).

question: What information is exempted from disclosure under Section 8 of the RTI Act?
ground_truth: National security, commercial confidence, trade secrets, and personal information without public interest.

question: What is the official online portal to file consumer cases across India?
ground_truth: e-Daakhil portal (edaakhil.nic.in) under Section 35 of CPA 2019.

question: How is the PM-KISAN financial benefit disbursed to farmers?
ground_truth: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts in three four-monthly installments of Rs 2000.

question: I bought a defective LED TV for Rs 42000, company refused to honour warranty, where do I complain?
ground_truth: District Consumer Commission under Section 34 & 35 of Consumer Protection Act 2019.

question: I booked an apartment worth Rs 85 Lakhs and the developer failed to deliver possession in 3 years.
ground_truth: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission under Section 47 of CPA 2019 (Rs 50 Lakhs to 2 Crores).

question: Commercial hospital machinery purchase worth Rs 2.5 Crores arrived damaged, supplier refuses replacement.
ground_truth: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission under Section 58 of CPA 2019 (Above 2 Crores).

question: CPIO rejected my application for public works expenditure citing confidential company data.
ground_truth: First Appeal before the First Appellate Authority under Section 19(1) of RTI Act 2005.

question: Can information concerning life and liberty be delayed beyond 48 hours under RTI?
ground_truth: No, Section 7(1) mandates provision within 48 hours for life and liberty matters.

question: माझ्या शेतात पीएम किसान योजनेचा हप्ता जमा झालेला नाही, कोणती पूर्तता आवश्यक आहे?
ground_truth: पीएम किसान मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वानुसार आधार ई-केवायसी आणि बँक खात्याशी आधार संलग्न असणे आवश्यक आहे.

question: आयुष्मान भारत योजनेंतर्गत कोणत्या आजारांवर मोफत उपचार मिळतात?
ground_truth: नोंदणीकृत रुग्णालयांमध्ये दुय्यम आणि तृतीयक उपचारांसाठी प्रति कुटुंब वार्षिक ५ लाख रुपयांपर्यंत मोफत उपचार.

question: ग्राहक संरक्षण कायद्यानुसार ग्राहकांना कोणकोणते ६ मूलभूत अधिकार दिलेले आहेत?
ground_truth: कलम २(९) अंतर्गत सुरक्षितता, माहिती, निवड, सुनावणी, तक्रार निवारण आणि ग्राहक शिक्षणाचा अधिकार.

question: शासकीय कामांच्या निविदांची माहिती मागवण्यासाठी कोणत्या कलमांतर्गत अर्ज करावा लागतो?
ground_truth: माहिती अधिकार कायदा २००५ च्या कलम ६ अंतर्गत जन माहिती अधिकाऱ्याकडे अर्ज करावा लागतो.

question: दुकानदार एमआरपीपेक्षा जास्त पैसे आकारत असल्यास ग्राहक न्यायालयात दाद मागता येते का?
ground_truth: होय, अनुचित व्यापारी प्रथा मानून कलम ३५ अंतर्गत जिल्हा ग्राहक आयोगाकडे तक्रार दाखल करता येते.

question: What is the fee if information is not provided within the 30-day statutory limit under RTI?
ground_truth: Information must be provided free of charge under Section 7(6) of RTI Act 2005.

question: Can a consumer complaint be filed electronically without hiring a lawyer?
ground_truth: Yes, complainant can file directly via e-Daakhil under Section 35 of CPA 2019 without mandatory advocate.

question: Is cultivable land holding mandatory for PM-KISAN cash assistance?
ground_truth: Yes, the farmer family must own cultivable land as per state land records.

question: Does Ayushman Bharat require any enrolment fee or premium from the beneficiary?
ground_truth: No, it is 100% government funded with zero fee or premium for eligible beneficiaries.

question: What grounds exempt a public authority from disclosing information under RTI Section 8(1)(j)?
ground_truth: Personal information having no relationship to any public activity or which causes unwarranted invasion of privacy.

question: What relief can a District Commission award to an aggrieved consumer under CPA 2019?
ground_truth: Removal of defects, replacement of goods, refund of price, and compensation for loss or injury under Section 38.

question: What happens if a CPIO gives misleading information knowingly?
ground_truth: Information Commission can impose a penalty of Rs 250 per day up to Rs 25,000 under Section 20.

question: Can an appeal be filed against the order of the District Consumer Commission?
ground_truth: Yes, appeal lies to the State Commission within 45 days under Section 41 & 47 of CPA 2019.

question: How are welfare benefits protected against ghost beneficiaries in PM-KISAN?
ground_truth: Mandatory biometric/OTP Aadhaar eKYC, land record seeding, and NPCI DBT verification.

question: What constitutes deficiency of service under the Consumer Protection Act 2019?
ground_truth: Any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in quality, nature and manner of performance required by law.
